flags.message: Forecast completed from the available record. The snapshot lists an August 25, 2026 reply, but no reply text is provisioned or independently retrieved; Utah's latest answer to the BIO's finality and alternative-ground objections is therefore unassessed. The 154-page petition source is marked truncated, although its main argument and relevant appended opinion passages are available. Neither limitation was treated as evidence of an absent filing or an outcome.
